_comment: Fleet-wide identity/content guardrails. 'blocked' terms hard-fail any commit — no override, ever. 'warn' terms only fail if an AI classifier judges the surrounding context to actually refer to the protected identity (news articles/unrelated people pass). Per-repo entries in 'overrides' are ADDITIVE ONLY — a repo can add terms, never remove a global one. Edit via the Fleet Dashboard Guardrails tab, or directly here (this file is NOT mounted read-write into any site container, so agents cannot self-edit it).
